Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the sale of in-vehicle electronic toll collection system equipment.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the sale of in-vehicle electronic tollcollection system equipment; and adding a new section to chapter 47.56RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.56 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department must post signs near all tolled facilities toinform the travelling public where invehicle electronic tollcollection system equipment is sold. The department may advertise aprivate business that sells invehicle electronic toll collectionsystem equipment if the private business pays for the cost ofmanufacturing and maintaining the sign. (2) The department must provide invehicle electronic tollcollection system equipment through automated vending machines at statesafety rest areas located on Interstate 5 and Interstate 90.
